mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.price, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.sales, p.stock, p.tag, p.skus, p.on_sale AS onSale, p.deleted, p.shop_id AS shopId, s.name AS shopName, s.score AS shopScore, f.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM footprints f JOIN products p ON p.id = f.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shops s ON s.shop_id = p.shop_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.updated_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
